There's a plastic wall inside your phone thinner than most human hairs. If it fails, your phone can catch fire. 🔥

It keeps your battery's two sides apart, so electrons have to take the long way round, through your phone. Pierce it, and they take the shortcut. That's what happened inside some Galaxy Note 7 batteries in 2016.

Every bitcoin payment waits in a public waiting room called the mempool before it's confirmed, and bots can read it. 👀

This morning (27 Oct, 06:55 UTC) mempool.space showed 46,656 unconfirmed transactions. Miners take the highest fee rates first; on Ethereum, bots watch the mempool for big trades and sandwich them.

About 3.7 million bitcoin are probably lost forever: nearly 1 in 5 that exist, around $300B today (Chainalysis estimate).
Bitcoin has no password reset. Lose the private key and the coins sit on the public record where nobody can move them. Even the first 50 BTC ever created can't be spent.
